key_idea: Each cut makes one more piece, so count the cuts and add 1.
steps: There are 3 gray blades. Look at each one and count how many parts of the rope it crosses.
The left blade crosses only the top part of the rope: 1 cut. The long middle blade crosses the top part and the middle part: 2 cuts.
The right blade crosses only the bottom part: 1 cut. So there are 1 + 2 + 1 = 4 cuts.

choice_feedback.A: That is too few. There are 4 cuts, and each cut makes one more piece.
choice_feedback.B: 4 is the number of cuts. 4 cuts make 1 more piece than that.
choice_feedback.D: That is too many. There are only 4 cuts, so 5 pieces.
